subject: Quick check: BlueHarbor security packet & next steps
messages:
From: Jorge Ruiz <jorge@blueharbor.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@blueharbor.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro / discovery — quick follow-up

Thanks for the call earlier, Laura. Quick note from our side:
- We're evaluating inference vendors for a pilot to embed into our analytics platform (1–2 models initially).
- Primary concerns: data isolation, audit logging, and predictable latency.
- Legal will want SOC 2 scope and any encryption details.

Can you send over your SOC 2 summary and any network diagrams? Also, what does typical onboarding look like (time + key milestones)?

—Jorge
Sr. Platform Engineer, BlueHarbor Analytics
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>
To: Jorge Ruiz <jorge@blueharbor.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodai.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro / discovery — quick follow-up

Jorge — thanks for the questions and for outlining priorities. Per our call, attaching a short SOC 2 summary that highlights our scope (inference plane, control plane separation), encryption-at-rest and in-transit, and logging/audit retention. Also attached a simple network diagram showing VPC peering and options for private deployment.

High-level onboarding timeline:
- Week 0: Contract + security addendum
- Week 1–2: Private config & credentialing (KMS, VPC setup)
- Week 3: Model onboarding + smoke tests
- Week 4: Pilot run / initial SLO verification

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf (PDF, 1.1MB); network-architecture-diagram.png (PNG, 240KB)

If helpful, Aditya (cc'd) can run through the technical checklist with your infra team; Monica can own contract/terms. What timeline are you targeting for the pilot?

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Singh <priya.s@blueharbor.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Jorge Ruiz <jorge@blueharbor.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro / discovery — quick follow-up

Laura — thanks for sending these over. We got the SOC 2 summary and the diagram. A couple of quick clarifying questions from our security reviewer:
1) What is your max retention for audit logs by default, and can that be configured per account?
2) For the private deployment option, do you support customer-managed KMS (HSM) or only cloud KMS?

We're aiming for a pilot kickoff in mid‑March but need security sign-off before contracting. Can you confirm the answers so we can move this to legal?

—Priya
InfoSec Lead, BlueHarbor Analytics
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.s@blueharbor.com>, Jorge Ruiz <jorge@blueharbor.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodai.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Quick check: BlueHarbor security packet & next steps

Hi Priya / Jorge — wanted to follow up in case the previous note slipped through. Quick answers inline to Priya's questions:
1) Audit logs: default retention is 90 days; we offer configurable retention up to 7 years for enterprise plans (configurable per account).
2) KMS: For Private deployments we support customer-managed KMS, including HSM-backed keys via partner integrations; for Hosted we integrate with cloud KMS options.

Next suggested steps to keep to the mid‑March pilot target:
- Legal: review security summary + addendum (Monica will share the security addendum draft by Monday)
- Technical: 30–45 minute checklist call with Aditya to confirm VPC/KMS details — propose Tues, 24 Feb at 10am PT
- Contracting: if legal okays the addendum, we can issue an SOW draft the same week

If these sound good, can you confirm availability for the checklist call and whether there are any blockers on your side reviewing the packet?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to walk through specifics.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2025.pdf, network-architecture-diagram.png
